doc: The Words page (Help in the pause menu, Help on the title): one plain line per term, in the canon wording (briefs/DECISIONS.md, briefs/LORE_MASKS.md). A term shows once its 'seen' rule holds: {} always, {tut: key} a Save.d tutorial flag, {matches: n} that many expeditions played. Budget (checked by --words-check): max_words per line, max_chars per line.

words.line: The cursed mask of a fallen Hunter. Take one up and you become them.
What you become when you put on a Relic. Every player in a match is one.
Your Boki's soul, orbiting you in a match as a small critter-shaped light.
Your Boki wisp bursts into the full Boki for a short time, then shrinks back.
Leave the expedition with what you carry. Only extracted loot comes home.
A downed Hunter pops into a round glowing Wisp, until a friend revives them.
A Hunter merged with their Boki. It needs a full bond meter.
The Wyrm's blood. Each match it closes in toward the Heart.
The Wyrmheart: one wish to remake the world, or rule it. Every Hunter wants it.
A mote of the Heart's light that charges at its site. Everyone sees where.
